items.q: Jessie Price, he was one of the main ones, you know, and he started that

ctx.x: You mentioned 'Hootie Blues', but you haven't explained how you go that nickname.

I tell you that nickname came from -- actually it came from when I first came to Kansas City, you know how it is with guys, new cat in town, here plays piano, so I would go down to cat's gigs and listen to different musicians so this particular night I went on down to the Greenleaf Club, so down there they would have that real cold beer but they would spike it with alcohol or gin so -- and the weather was nice and warm so when they passed it to me, man, it just tasted so good and cold. See, the alcohol got a…

taste sweet, man, this is the best beer and I'm not a beer drinker and they'd pass it to the next guy and he would drink it and then pass it back to that new cat. Well, they're tricking me, see, they just take a little sip. Well, I'm thinking this is good beer and I would hold it up there and pass it on to somebody. Man, treat the visitor right.
